title: K12 keychain read hidden inside a project npm script
reason_not_testable: The hook sees only the command text npm run usage and cannot see the inner security call or an unharvested value, so the expected outcome is a residual gap. A fixture would have to assert that a fake secret leaks, which passes under --null and proves no protection. Non-hook control: keychain item ACL so the agent process cannot read the item silently, and no stored credentials in the login keychain for this item.
